stories.definitionOfDone: • Architecture Design: The architecture design document includes: system components diagram, data flow diagrams, interface specifications, and technology stack decisions. The data collection module is designed to handle at least six types of weather instruments (temperature, pressure, sunshine, rainfall, wind speed, and direction) with reliable and efficient data processing.
stories.description: The system must collect weather data from instruments measuring temperature, pressure, sunshine, rainfall, wind speed, and direction
stories.title: Collect Weather Data From Instruments

stories.definitionOfDone: • Unit Tests: Unit tests pass reliably, covering the local data processing logic, with no unexpected errors or failures
stories.description: The system must perform initial data processing locally before transmission to the Data Management and Archiving System
stories.title: Perform Initial Data Processing Locally

stories.definitionOfDone: • Architecture Design: The design includes a satellite communication module with retry logic that reliably handles network failures and ensures efficient transmission of data.
stories.description: The system must transmit data via satellite communication when available
stories.title: Transmit Data Via Satellite Communication

stories.definitionOfDone: • Database Schema Design: The database schema includes: all required tables with relationships, indexes for performance, data validation rules, and migration scripts. Schema is reviewed and approved.
stories.description: The system must store data locally when communication is unavailable

stories.title: Store Data Locally When Communication

stories.definitionOfDone: • User Training Documentation: The user training documentation includes: step-by-step instructions on instrument monitoring, screenshots of key features, and troubleshooting guides. The document is reviewed and approved by the product team.
stories.description: The Station Software must monitor instruments, power, and communication hardware, reporting faults to the Management System
stories.title: Station Software Monitor Instruments Power

stories.definitionOfDone: • Production Support Plan: The production support plan includes: detailed procedures for generator shutdown, battery charging procedures, and communication protocols for emergency situations. The plan is reviewed and approved by the stakeholder.
stories.description: The Station Software must manage system power, ensuring battery charging when possible but shutting down generators in potentially damaging weather conditions
stories.title: Station Software Manage Power Ensuring

stories.definitionOfDone: • Architecture Design: The architecture design document includes: system components diagram showing clear separation of concerns, data flow diagrams illustrating communication between components, interface specifications for all interactions, and technology stack decisions that enable efficient updates. All components are documented with their responsibilities and interactions.
stories.description: The Station Software must allow for dynamic reconfiguration by replacing software components with new versions and switching backup instruments into the system in case of failure
stories.title: Station Software Allow Dynamic Reconfiguration
